pkgmetadata.longdescription: Engine of Kintsugi-27B, a fork of llama.cpp: Escha W2 / EXL3 trellis weight files, a tiered K/V cache split between VRAM and system RAM, a two-stage output head, and MTP, prompt-lookup and DFlash2 block drafting. Stock llama.cpp cannot load the Kintsugi model file. Installed under /opt/llama-kintsugi with kintsugi- prefixed symlinks in /usr/bin to coexist with sci-misc/llama-cpp.

use.flag: Serve and fetch over HTTPS with dev-libs/openssl
